result.instructions: Tools for Addressfinder, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Is 184 Willis Street, Wellington a valid NZ address, and what is its postcode?"; "Find the NZ addresses nearest to these GPS coordinates: -41.2865, 174.7762."; "Suggest AU addresses for '10 Martin pl Sydney' and show the full details of the best match.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Addressfinder data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run addressfinder_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run addressfinder_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run addressfinder_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. addressfinder_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: addressfinder_nz_address_autocomplete
tools.title: NZ address autocomplete
tools.description: Search NZ addresses from a partial address. Returns candidates with `a` (the address) and `pxid`. Pair each call with addressfinder_nz_address_metadata: call it with the chosen pxid to load the full address.

q.description: The text to search or verify, for example a partial or full address.

post_box.description: 0 excludes PO Box addresses. 1 returns PO Box addresses only.

tools.name: addressfinder_nz_address_metadata
tools.title: NZ address metadata
tools.description: Load the full metadata for one NZ address, given the pxid from addressfinder_nz_address_autocomplete or addressfinder_nz_reverse_geocode. Returns the parsed address parts, postcode, dpid and coordinates.

pxid.description: The pxid from the matching autocomplete or reverse geocode tool.

tools.name: addressfinder_nz_address_verify
tools.title: Verify NZ address
tools.description: Verify one full NZ address, which may contain typos, against the Addressfinder database. Returns the matched address and its metadata when a match exists. Each verified result is one billed Lookup.

q.description: The text to search or verify, for example a partial or full address.

post_box.description: 0 excludes PO Box addresses. 1 returns PO Box addresses only.

tools.name: addressfinder_nz_reverse_geocode
tools.title: NZ reverse geocode
tools.description: Find the nearest NZ addresses to a GPS point, ordered by distance. Returns `a` and `pxid` for each. Pair with addressfinder_nz_address_metadata for the chosen pxid.

tools.name: addressfinder_nz_location_autocomplete
tools.title: NZ location autocomplete
tools.description: Search NZ streets, suburbs, cities and regions (locations). Returns candidates with `a` and `pxid`. Pair each call with addressfinder_nz_location_metadata for the chosen pxid. To return several location types, set the others to 0.

q.description: The text to search or verify, for example a partial or full address.

tools.name: addressfinder_nz_location_metadata
tools.title: NZ location metadata
tools.description: Load the metadata for one NZ location (street, suburb, city or region), given the pxid from addressfinder_nz_location_autocomplete. Returns the canonical name and coordinates.

pxid.description: The pxid from the matching autocomplete or reverse geocode tool.

tools.name: addressfinder_au_address_autocomplete
tools.title: AU address autocomplete
tools.description: Search AU addresses from a partial address. Returns candidates with `full_address` and `id`. Pair each call with addressfinder_au_address_metadata: call it with the chosen id to load the full address.

q.description: The text to search or verify, for example a partial or full address.

post_box.description: 0 excludes PO Box addresses. 1 returns PO Box addresses only.

state_codes.description: Comma-separated states or territories to filter by, for example NSW,VIC.

tools.name: addressfinder_au_address_metadata
tools.title: AU address metadata
tools.description: Load the full metadata for one AU address, given the id from addressfinder_au_address_autocomplete. Returns the parsed address parts, postcode, coordinates and GNAF identifiers.

id.description: The id from the matching autocomplete tool.

tools.name: addressfinder_au_address_verify
tools.title: Verify AU address
tools.description: Verify one full AU address, which may contain typos, against Australia Post PAF and Geoscape GNAF data. Returns whether it matched and the matched address. Each verified result is one billed Lookup.

q.description: The text to search or verify, for example a partial or full address.

tools.name: addressfinder_au_location_autocomplete
tools.title: AU location autocomplete
tools.description: Search AU streets, localities (suburbs) and states (locations). Returns candidates with `full_location` and `id`. Pair each call with addressfinder_au_location_metadata for the chosen id.

q.description: The text to search or verify, for example a partial or full address.

location_types.description: Comma-separated location types: street, locality, state. Omit the parameter to return all types.

state_codes.description: Comma-separated states or territories to filter by, for example NSW,VIC.

tools.name: addressfinder_au_location_metadata
tools.title: AU location metadata
tools.description: Load the metadata for one AU location (street, locality or state), given the id from addressfinder_au_location_autocomplete. Returns the full location, type, coordinates and state.

id.description: The id from the matching autocomplete tool.
